title: Momcozy KleanPal Pro All-in-One Bottle Washer, Sterilizer & Dryer - White
bullets: 𝐔𝐋𝐓𝐈𝐌𝐀𝐓𝐄 𝐓𝐈𝐌𝐄-𝐒𝐀𝐕𝐈𝐍𝐆 & 𝐂𝐋𝐄𝐀𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐒𝐎𝐋𝐔𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍: Automatically washes, sterilizes, and dries baby bottles, pump parts, baby tableware, and more, saving you precious time to spend with your family.

𝟐𝟔 𝐏𝐎𝐖𝐄𝐑𝐅𝐔𝐋 𝐒𝐏𝐑𝐀𝐘 𝐉𝐄𝐓𝐒 𝐅𝐎𝐑 𝐓𝐇𝐎𝐑𝐎𝐔𝐆𝐇 𝐂𝐋𝐄𝐀𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆: No single stained spot will be missed, as 12 directional spray jets in 4 sets brush the interior of each bottle, while 10 swirling spray jets cleanse the surface.

𝐖𝐄𝐀𝐑𝐀𝗕𝐋𝐄 𝐏𝐔𝐌𝐏 𝐏𝐀𝐑𝐓 𝐒𝐀𝐅𝐄: Pop in your baby bottles, as well as your wearable pump parts. Momcozy bottle washer has a dual-layer design that holds up to 4 bottles from most major brands and other baby items at a time.

𝟵 𝐂𝐋𝐄𝐀𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐌𝐎𝐃𝐄𝐒 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝗕𝐈𝐍𝐀𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍 𝐓𝐎 𝐂𝐇𝐎𝐎𝐒𝐄 𝐅𝐑𝐎𝐌: Freely combine the four modes (Rapid Wash, Normal Wash, Sterilize+Dry, Storage) and customize your settings. In a rush? Opt for the Quick Wash mode, which efficiently cleans your bottles in just 19 minutes.
𝐄𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐂𝐓𝐈𝐕𝐄 𝐒𝐓𝐄𝐀𝐌 𝐒𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐈𝐋𝐈𝗭𝐈𝐍𝐆: Creates a safe and hygienic feeding environment for your baby’s health.

𝐒𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐈𝐋𝐄 𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐎𝐑𝐃𝐄𝐑𝐋𝐄𝐒𝐒 𝐒𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐀𝗚𝗘: Keep bottles dry and clean in the washer for up to 72 hours after washing. The airflow is purified by the medical-grade H13 HEPA filter, removing 99.9% airborne particles.
